metadata.description: Agent Skill for the ilo programming language

plugins.name: ilo
plugins.description: Write, run, debug, and explain programs in ilo — a token-optimised programming language for AI agents

skills.name: ilo-language
skills.description: Use this when writing or reviewing .ilo source.

skills.name: ilo-builtins-core
skills.description: Use this for core builtins: type coercions, list ops, HOFs, and map ops.

skills.name: ilo-builtins-math
skills.description: Use this for math builtins: arithmetic, trig, constants, random, and statistics.

skills.name: ilo-builtins-io
skills.description: Use this for I/O builtins: file read/write, HTTP, JSON, path ops, env, time, and process.

skills.name: ilo-builtins-text
skills.description: Use this for text builtins: manipulation, regex, formatting, CSV/TSV, and date parsing.

skills.name: ilo-errors
skills.description: Use this when reading ILO-XXXX error codes or fixing failures.

skills.name: ilo-tools
skills.description: Use this when declaring or using MCP tools in ilo programs.

skills.name: ilo-engines
skills.description: Use this when choosing between tree, VM, JIT, or AOT execution.

skills.name: ilo-agent
skills.description: Use this when integrating ilo into an agent loop.

skills.name: ilo-examples
skills.description: Use this when looking for a runnable pattern for the kind of task you are doing.

skills.name: ilo-edit-loop
skills.description: Use this when an ilo program fails and you need to recover or iterate.
